<?php
class SelectorBase232 { public $tag=9; public static function capture($saved,$ignored) { echo "CAPTURE:",self::class,":",static::class,";"; return $saved; } public function __destruct() { echo "SELECTOR-END;"; } } class SelectorChild232 extends SelectorBase232 {} class Replacement232 {}
function shift232() { $GLOBALS["selector"]=new Replacement232; $GLOBALS["argument"]=new New232; $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class Old232 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New232 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Magic232 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"]=null; echo "HANDLER:",($arguments[0] instanceof Old232)?"OLD;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$argument=new Old232; $owner=new Magic232; $selector=new SelectorChild232; $reference =& $selector; $result=$owner->MiSsInG($reference->capture($argument,shift232())); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";
